question: Who was the first Indian, and Asian, tennis player to win an Olympic medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Leander Paes.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leander Paes **won a **bronze medal **in the **men's singles tennis** event at the** 1996 Atlanta Olympics,** making him the **first Indian and Asian tennis** player to win an Olympic medal.
 
• Ankita Raina, PV Sindhu, and Purav Raja have **not** won Olympic medals in tennis.
 
• **PV Sindhu **has won an** Olympic medal **in badminton, but not in tennis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Leander Paes** is a **former Indian tennis player **who has won **multiple Grand Slam titles **in doubles and mixed doubles events.
 
• **Ankita Raina **is a **current Indian tennis player **who has won several** ITF singles and doubles titles.**
 
• **PV Sindhu** is an **Indian badminton player **who won a** silver medal **in the **women's singles event** at the **2016 Olympics.**
 
• **Purav Raja **is a **current Indian tennis player** who has won several **ATP doubles titles.**
